//: CTO V54 — P10 AI-governance E4→E5 transition criteria. P10 STAYS at E4 until EVERY condition below is met=true AND an independent controller signs off. E5 requires a real authorised client, real documented AI systems, a lawful data basis, real execution, observed/verifiable results, written client validation and qualified legal confirmation. ODG prepares readiness evidence; it NEVER certifies, gives legal advice, or guarantees compliance. Nothing here authorises prospecting, contracts, spend or external communication.
title: AI Governance / AI-Act & GDPR readiness

e4Evidence.basis: SIMULATED classifications/gaps on synthetic declared activities — never OBSERVED, never certified, never legal advice

transitionConditions.condition: A real client explicitly authorises an engagement (signed scope by the owner).
Perimeter and responsibilities written (AI systems in/out of scope; who owns which obligation).
Lawful basis and data access established (AI-system inventory, technical/vendor docs, risk assessments) — minimised, documented.
Execution on the real context: roles classified from VERIFIED (not merely declared) activities; controls assessed against real evidence.
Observed, verifiable results: each obligation carries real evidence; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is resolved or explicitly carried with a plan.
Qualified legal confirmation: every LEGAL_OBLIGATION / NEEDS_LEGAL_EXPERTISE item confirmed by competent counsel (ODG does not give legal advice).
Written client validation of the findings and remediation plan.
Independent controller review of the whole engagement (ODG retains authority; Claude Code = technical provider only).

acceptanceCriteria: At least one OBSERVED/verified-evidence item replaces a SIMULATED classification.
Each requirement correctly typed (LEGAL_OBLIGATION / CONDITIONAL_REQUIREMENT / GOOD_PRACTICE / RECOMMENDATION / HYPOTHESIS / NEEDS_LEGAL_EXPERTISE) and legal items confirmed by counsel.
Independent evidence digest verifies (O2.verifyEvidence ok) over the real deliverable.
Controller sign-off recorded; owner authorisation recorded.
rejectionCriteria: The report presented as a certification, a legal opinion, or a compliance guarantee.
Any obligation asserted in force without a dated, sourced basis (register-silent ⇒ UNKNOWN_DATE must stay unknown).
Data accessed without a documented lawful basis or beyond the agreed perimeter.
A listed-but-untested control reported as PASS (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE must stay INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE).
No independent controller review, or counsel withholds confirmation, or client does not validate in writing.
regulatoryPosture: ODG prepares AI-Act/GDPR readiness evidence. Dates are injected data to be confirmed against authoritative texts by qualified counsel. NOT a certification, NOT legal advice, NOT a conformity guarantee.
invariant: Until all conditions are met=true, P10 remains E4 and e5Status remains NOT_STARTED. Simulated classifications are NEVER presented as observed or certified. ODG keeps authority; an independent controller and qualified legal expertise are mandatory.
nonGoals: No prospecting, no external message, no contract, no spend, no subscription, no hiring.
No CRM or parallel registry — reuse the nine primitives, P10 guard, O1/O2, ai-act-in-force, existing evidence.
No push, merge, deployment or VPS access; no background process; no npm privilege escalation.
